title: Studio home loop: Back to home returns to the Studio landing; the two Setup exits say so
body:
## Source

Measured on objectui main `d4bc81eab`, 2026-10-15. Inside a package the shell header's first button, "Back to home" (`engine.studio.home`, `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`), navigates to `/home`, the console home. The Studio landing (`/studio`, `BuilderLanding.tsx`: recently viewed, my packages, not in a package, installed) has no way back from inside a package: the package switcher lists packages, Organization flows, Package info & settings and New package, not the landing. On the landing, "Customize with an overlay" opens Setup › All Metadata Types (`/apps/setup/metadata?package=…`) and the Organization flows surface (`/studio/~org/automations`) tells an empty rail to "Clone a packaged flow in Setup › Packaged automation"; both leave Studio without saying so.

## Target

1. The header's first button returns to the Studio landing (`/studio`); the console home stays one click away through the landing's own top bar (the ObjectOS mark already links to `/home`).
2. The package switcher's first row is "Studio home" (the landing), above the package list.
3. The two Setup exits read "Open in Setup" with an outward icon, on the landing's installed cards and in the Organization flows empty state, the latter linking straight to the packaged-automation list it names.

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (home button, package switcher), `BuilderLanding.tsx`, `apps/console/src/components/StudioRoute.tsx` if the route needs it, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. A test asserts the home button navigates to `/studio` and the switcher's first row to the landing.
2. Screenshots: the landing's installed card and the Organization flows empty state with the Setup labels, light and dark.
3. `StudioDesignSurface.*.test.tsx` green.

## Constraints

- No change to Setup.
- Existing `data-testid`s and i18n keys stay; new keys in every locale.

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-15 Studio test pass: objectui main `d4bc81eab`, HotCRM `63db83e2`, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack serve --dev` on :4001, viewport 1482 × 1119, dark theme with a light-theme check.</sub>

## Evidence

Screenshots from the test pass, kept on the temporary branch `claude/studio-test-pass-evidence-20261015` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `72115588c`, never merged: the maintainer ruled that screenshots do not enter main, and asked for a temporary branch referenced from the card). The branch's `docs/design/studio-redesign/findings/2026-10-15/README.md` maps every file to its card. Pane captures, 800 × 604 of a 1482 × 1119 viewport, dark unless named light.
